title: AI Intelligence & Insights
notes: Insights/Recommendations, Document Scans, and (implicitly via listSmartFollowups) Smart Follow-ups are now backed by real list endpoints with dismiss/action/apply/reject wired up; document-scans is a full ListPage with row detail drawer, bulk apply/reject, and CSV export. Lead Score index and Smart Follow-ups now use RelationCombobox instead of raw lead-ID text inputs. Lead Score detail adds a recalculate action and a history timeline. Still orphaned/not surfaced in UI: nl-query (POST) and nl-queries history, insights/predictions and insights/customer/:contactId (no natural entry point in this slice — nl-query and per-contact insight surfaces belong to other slices). OCR page still does client-side-only scanning preview; applying now routes to the Document Scans queue rather than duplicating apply logic inline. urlPrefill/phoneInput/addressAutocomplete/currencyInput/sendMessageDialog are not applicable — this slice has no address/phone/currency/relation-creation forms and outbound messaging is a server-triggered send (smart-followups/:id/send), not a client compose dialog.
showcaseScript: Open AI → Insights and read the generated recommendations
Ask a natural-language question about pipeline revenue
Open a lead score and show the contributing factors
Scan a passport with OCR and apply the extracted fields
